name: Edwards AFB
description: Home of 412th Test Wing — premier Air Force flight test center.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate. All visitors must obtain a base pass at the Visitor Control Center at West Gate.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit the Military Personnel Flight within required timelines. Attend the newcomers briefing at the M&FRC.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Management Office before arrival. High Desert Inn offers temporary lodging — book early during PCS season. Dorm management handles unaccompanied housing.

sections.title: Gate Access
sections.body: West Gate (Main), North Gate, and South Gate are open 24/7. Visitor Control Center at West Gate, Bldg 1004, is Mon-Fri 0700-1600. REAL ID required for all visitors.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official installation resources plus Military OneSource and BaseDirectory for relocation support.
